items.title: Billy Taylor — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ernie, what was his name, a guy named Ernie Washington who was a young guy.

ctx.x: After school, when you are working in D.C. for that intermediate time. You know what did…

Almost everybody who was a good musician was drafted so the music scene was filled with women and people who were itinerate. I remember guys like Fats Wright a very fine pianist from Philadelphia who influenced Bud Pal and a lot of other folks, came down. Fats Wright was there for a while. Ernie, what was his name, a guy named Ernie Washington who was a young guy. I think he got drafted though but he was there for a short time. He played trumpet and piano. And a bunch of musicians came through D.C. from various…

What about the mood with the African American community at that time because you are hearing people like Billy Epstein on those V discs, you know you talk about the patriotism of African Americans throughout our history here and can you comment on that?
